biography.concept: Letter-mason — Kabbalist association, echo of Marginalia
biography.notes: He carved the correction into a load-bearing glyph that saved Marginalia's arm at Threshhold Nine, and the stiffness never left his own hands — he still sends the bill as a joke, but he means it a little.

description.value:
Stalwart — Apprentice (Tier I).

Trade — Haul and raise: A day's heavy labor — cargo moved, wall raised, field cleared. Standard fee 10 marks (Economy).

Trick — Put Your Back Into It (1/scene): Auto-succeed one feat of raw strength or endurance of tier-appropriate difficulty.

"The Shattering didn't end the work. Nothing ends the work."

Stalwart is the Body Calling — the trade that kept its bearers alive after the Shattering. Umbrella: laborer, teamster, forager, wall-crew, rig-hand, survivor. A profession is a flavor label on the Calling.

Knack — Hazard-Hardened: Reduce each environmental hazard/radiation tick by 1 (by 2 at Tier III), and labor output counts double for facility/build work.

Aptitude kit: signature aptitude Athletics rank = tier; secondary Plating rank = tier − 1.

Services: a standard job costs the tier fee (T1 10 / T2 30 / T3 90 / T4 270 marks), paid in Economy marks. Cross-pool ×1.5 friction applies as usual.

Tiers: Apprentice → Initiate → Master → Archon. Grant the matching tier features alongside this class item.

Awakens into: Bulwark or Soul-Smith. A Steward is a Calling that ignited into a Path — Surge is the mark of Stewardship, which is why no Calling banks or spends it.

Echoes are the past made flesh — people out of a Steward's former lives, walking beside them again. Corvin Ashtabel is an echo of Marginalia's time with the Kabbalist occult association. Being remembered leaves a mark.

Letter-mason — He carved the correction into a load-bearing glyph that saved Marginalia's arm at Threshhold Nine, and the stiffness never left his own hands — he still sends the bill as a joke, but he means it a little.

Letter of Making — Apprentice (Echo Boon)

Once per scene, inscribe one Letter upon a door or object: it counts sealed and warded, −1 to any attempt to breach it, until the scene ends.

Echo's Mark: while their Steward can see them, the echo adds +1 on any check made in direct support of the Steward.

Some letters were taught to them before the world got its name back.

Sephirotic Scion. Your blood remembers the higher spheres. Light hangs around you a little too long, prayers sometimes answer themselves, and the world’s moral architecture feels less like an abstraction and more like the weather report.

Sephirotic Scion Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Sephirotic).

  • Size. You are Medium.

  • Speed. Your walking speed is 6 squares

  • attributes. Your background determines your attribute increases; Sephirotic Scion does not grant any attribute bonuses.

Your Sephirotic heritage grants you additional features through advancements (Item Grants) added during character creation: sephirotic physiology, attunement to higher patterns, holy conduction, the Light of Harmony, and strategic hooks that tilt factions toward soft power, diplomacy, and alignment work.

description.value:
Sefirot Attunement. You perceive the harmonic structure beneath events.

  • You gain a bonus to Perception checks and passive Perception.
  • Your intuition occasionally warns you about moral or spiritual imbalances (GM discretion).

Holy Conduit. Your body routes excess metaphysical charge safely.

  • You have resistance to psychic damage.
  • Your presence stabilizes magically turbulent areas.
  • Bad Eden engines treat you as a low-level metaphysical conductor (see world logic).

“You glow a little. Sometimes metaphorically. Sometimes not.”

  • You can cast calm emotions 1/Soma Break (Presence is your manifestation aptitude).
  • Allies within 2 squares reroll the lowest die on checks against being frightened.
  • You automatically sense the Sephirothic/Qliphothic tilt of any hex you enter.

changes.value: Allies within 10 feet gain advantage on saves vs frightened.

description.value:
“Even the world listens when you walk in.”

  • Your faction gains +2 Soft Power OP and +1 Diplomacy OP.
  • Shifting a controlled hex toward a Sephirah costs 10% less.
  • The first Spark Identification each chapter is free.

Bad Eden Heritage (v1.1, RFI-native). Sephirotic Scion heritage: Seraphic.

“What the Seraphim did to the wicked was sing them clean. Try not to be wicked around one.”

Sephirotic Scion (Seraphic). Your blood runs burning. The Seraphim are six-winged fire — the order closest to the throne, the order whose job is purification. You don’t run hot in the Igneous Menhirkin sense; you run hot in the moral sense. Things around you either align or combust. There is not a middle option.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Sephirotic Scion).

  • Size. Medium.

  • Movement. 6 squares walking.

  • Lineage Lean. Sephirotic Scion does not grant fixed attribute bonuses; your background handles increases. Your heritage leans toward Presence in fiction and through Tier powers.

Sephirotic Scion Core: The Higher Register

Shared across all Sephirotic Scion heritages. Granted at character creation via the base ancestry item.

  • Sephirotic Physiology. You have resistance to sephirotic damage. Your blood runs a little bright under the right light; you do not technically age while on consecrated ground.

  • Sefirot Attunement. At creation, pick one sephirah (player choice). Once per scene, you can invoke its register and gain a +1 rank bonus to one check that falls clearly within that sephirah's domain.

  • Holy Conduit. Manifestations, rituals, and other sephirotic-register effects that target you or pass through your space treat their effective caster-attribute as +1 for the duration of that effect. Works on allies and on you; does not work on qliphothic-register effects.

  • Light of Harmony. When two or more creatures within 6 squares of you are in active, explicit agreement (stated aloud), they each gain 1 temporary Integrity. This refreshes when a new agreement is reached between different creatures.

Seraphic Traits

  • Coal-Song. You know a minor manifestation that produces a single point of sephirotic damage at close range (flavor: holy fire). Your channel for it is Presence.

  • Unburning. You have resistance to sephirotic damage with the fire flavor, and to sephirotic damage. What you are is not flammable to itself.

Strategic Hooks (Foundry / Bad Eden)

  • OP Edge. Your faction gains +2 Faith OP and +1 Violence OP at campaign start.

  • Hex Synergy. In Consecrated / Pyre-Marked / Witnessed hexes, your faction's cleansing, judgment, and pyre operations cost 1 fewer OP.

  • Burning Witness. Once per Strategic Turn, when your faction confronts a rival faction in open negotiation, the rival must commit to one truth they would have preferred to conceal. The flame is close to the throne; lying hurts.

⟁ Per-Use Ability — Sefirot Attunement Recovery: 1/scene  ·  Action: Free (declare before roll)  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke. Invoke your chosen sephirah for +1 rank bonus on a check clearly in its domain.

Tier scaling: 3d10 at Tier 2 · 4d10 at Tier 3 · 5d10 at Tier 4.

Two-handed iron-headed maul on a long ash haft. Heavy, slow, and absolutely uninterested in your finesse. The Bulwark's first real weapon — the one you swing when subtlety has already failed.

Standard Issue. Heavy two-handed kinetic. No signature — Frame Dice and Ruin Charges still do their work; the maul just makes the impact mean it.
